records.source: Ten images of the Toxoplasma PV training set are published on Hugging Face as a small test dataset for Make Masks, with a button that loads the dataset and opens its first image in Make Masks.
records.context: Ten images of the Toxoplasma PV training set are published on Hugging Face as a small test dataset for Make Masks, with a button that loads the dataset and opens its first image in Make Masks.
records.translation: Toxoplasma PV 训练集中的十张图像已在 Hugging Face 上发布，作为 Make Masks 的小型测试数据集。按钮可加载该数据集，并在 Make Masks 中打开第一张图像。
